answer_2.quote: We evaluated our algorithm using the Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ) and DNS_MOS. Training Time and Real-Time Factor (RTF) were also reported.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a subjective audio evaluation using a 5-point Mean Opinion Score (MOS) test, involving 30 examples per model and 20 participants.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the generated audio on a 5-point scale evaluating its quality and naturalness.
